briefdescription.para: Per-screen count of document tail lines Display laid down as the live region last tick.

detaileddescription.para: Internal transient — message thread only, never exposed. The live tail is dynamic (grows/shrinks per tick); indexed by screen so a screen switch never reads the wrong screen's extent.

briefdescription.para: CONFIG/DISPLAY node handle — Display listens on this for config changes.
Constructs Display and parents Session's CodeView for rendering.

detaileddescription.para: Takes Session& — Display parents CodeView (owned by Session) for rendering via addAndMakeVisible. Resize flows through State: CodeView writes viewport, Session's Resizer calls prepare().

parameterdescription.para: The terminal session — provides CodeView (for rendering), CodeModel (for document mutation), and Processor (for input/events). Must outlive this Display.

briefdescription.para: Returns a string identifier for the pane type ("terminal" or "document").

detaileddescription.para: Used by Panes and Tabs to distinguish component types without RTTI.

simplesect.para: The pane type string — see Map::PaneType.

briefdescription.para: Applies the given zoom factor to the pane's rendering.
Copies the active selection to the system clipboard and clears selection.
Returns true if there is an active text selection.
Returns a mutable reference to the Processor that backs this Display.
Reads CONFIG/DISPLAY, writes font+caret to CODE_VIEW node, writes cell metrics to DISPLAY node.
